mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_review (order_id, goods_id, user_id, rating, content, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE goods_review SET rating = #{rating}, content = #{content}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, goods_id AS goodsId, user_id AS userId, rating, content, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM goods_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
